text.p: Following is a factfile on Arsenal striker Ian Wright, fined 15,000 pounds ($25,200) on Thursday for misconduct.
1991: Joins Arsenal from Crystal Palace in September. Fined 1,500 pounds ($2,520) for spitting and making obscene gestures to Oldham fans.
1992: Hits Tottenham player David Howells and is banned for three matches.
1993: Fined 5,000 pounds ($8,420) for making an obscene gesture at a linesman during the F.A. Cup Final.
1994: Fined 1,000 pounds ($1,680) for calling referee Robbie Hart a "muppet" and then an additional 750 pounds ($1,260) for spitting at a female QPR steward.
1995: Says referees are "incompetent little Hitlers". Later apologises.
1996: Sheffield United's Roger Nilsen accuses Wright of spitting in his face. Falls out with former Arsenal manager Bruce Rioch and threatens to leave the club. Persuaded to stay by fans.
February 1997: Clashes with Manchester United goalkeeper Peter Schmeichel and claims Schmeichel made racist remarks. Confronts Schmeichel in the tunnel after the match.
April 1997: Reported to F.A. for gestures made to crowd at Coventry and remarks made to the referee when playing match against Blackburn.
July 1997: Fined 15,000 pounds ($25,200) for Coventry and Blackburn offences and given severe warning by F.A.

* Wright been capped 27 times by England and scored eight goals. He has made 258 appearances for Arsenal, scoring 174 goals -- a total which leaves him just five goals short of beating Cliff Bastin's Arsenal scoring record of 178.
